description: A rooftop party at dusk with city towers, strings of lights and a brown balloon floating by. A young woman in a black slip dress holds up a fork with one tiny piece of chocolate cake on it, eats it and then looks unimpressed, holding a plate with the empty fork. Next to her on the long white table stands a huge four-tier chocolate cake with burning sparklers. Her friends at the table laugh, one covering his face and one filming with a phone. Stacks of plates and a big knife lie in front.
